role: Source-code-informed risk quantification of observed positive species-site loss during 20-row site normalization; no occupancy fitting.

verified_preconditions.scope_caution: Public hunviphab source version is pinned here but publication runtime SHA was not archived/verified. Results conditional on use of this version.

derived_quantities: Observed site-species positive indicator before sampling
n native raw rows per site, k positive rows per site/species
conditional probability of all k positive rows being excluded when sampling 20 rows
sum of probabilities across site-species positive pairs (expected lost pairs, not independent units)
raw vs normalized rows and site count per Q1/Q2
min/max expected-loss across four one-row-per-conflicting-ID hypotheses

math.for_1_le_n_le_20: ((n-k)/n)**20, for k>=1, sampling 20 rows WITH replacement
math.for_n_gt_20: product((n-k-j)/(n-j) for j=0..19) when n-k>=20, else 0; 20 rows WITHOUT replacement
math.correlation_note: Species losses at the same site are dependent because one resampled row set is reused; expected total is valid by linearity of expectation.

stops: no extrapolation to original actual fitted coefficients, seed, occupancy estimates or biological effects
do not claim that source replicate records are independent field survey occasions
do not use these expected lost values as statistically independent site replications
do not reopen three frozen EOG-WF predictive endpoints
do not perform a full model refit or infer causal abiotic-biotic-movement effects
do not call conditional 2022/2026 software source the exact historical package installation without a runtime lock
